s.n: Blue cheese, pear and walnut crostini
s.note: Blue cheese, pear and honeyed walnuts on toast. The pen is blue, says Fletcher.
s.how: Brush the bread with oil and bake at 190C until crisp. Toss the walnuts with half the honey in a hot pan until sticky, then cool. Beat the blue cheese with the cream cheese until spreadable. Spread on the toasts, top with pear and walnuts, drizzle with the remaining honey and scatter with thyme.
shop: 1 baguette, sliced thinly on an angle@Bakery

s.note: Mini franks in puff pastry, honey mustard.
s.how: Cut each pastry sheet into 12 strips. Roll a strip around each frankfurt, seam side down on a lined tray. Brush with egg, scatter with sesame and bake at 200C until puffed and golden.

m.note: Garlic and rosemary lamb, crisp potatoes, mint salsa verde.
m.how: Cut small slits all over the lamb and push in garlic slices and rosemary sprigs, then rub with oil and salt. Roast at 180C for about 1 hour 20 minutes for pink, then rest under foil. Parboil the potatoes, rough them up and roast in oil around the lamb for the last hour. Chop the mint, parsley and capers and stir in the lemon juice and olive oil. Carve the lamb and serve with the potatoes and salsa verde.

w.note: Chocolate layer cake, fudge frosting, candles.
w.how: Whisk the flour, 60g cocoa, sugar and baking powder, then beat in the eggs, milk and oil, and finally the hot coffee. Divide between two lined 20cm tins and bake at 180C until a skewer comes out clean. Beat the butter, icing sugar and 40g cocoa with a splash of milk until fluffy. Sandwich and cover the cooled cakes with the icing. Push in five candles, light them and make a wish.
shop: 60g cocoa powder, plus 40g for the icing@Pantry

d.note: Gin, lemon, honey and soda, tall. 24 hours of nothing but the truth.
d.how: Stir the honey into the warm water to make a syrup. Shake the gin, lemon juice and syrup with ice and strain into 4 tall glasses of ice. Top with soda and a lemon slice.

shopping: 1 baguette, sliced thinly on an angle@Bakery
60g cocoa powder, plus 40g for the icing@Pantry
